X.note: Tilted print on a dark textured background, with a clear gold-rule name block on the right. The name, role, place and year are all legible. The credit line sits over the bottom gradient on the print and has only moderate contrast. The text is largest where it matters (the name). Minor issue: the dark right side is a little empty.

Y.note: A nicely framed tilted print, but the caption sits on a gradient that crosses the white print border. The headline spans light and dark areas, so its contrast is uneven. The source line is small, grey and low-contrast, so it will be hard to read on a phone. Hoover is identified clearly, but the main text overlaps the photo, and the left edge looks slightly crowded.

why: X puts its text on a clean dark area beside the photo with strong contrast and a clear hierarchy, while Y's caption straddles the print and the gradient.
top_fix_for_weaker: Move the caption fully onto a solid dark band or beside the print, away from the white border. Make the source line larger and brighter, and use a stronger gradient or scrim behind the headline so the contrast is even.
